terra.problem: The psalm calls for rejoicing later, but it does not say laughing shows up.
Calling the question a trick comments on the choice card itself.
Referring to 'the stop' exposes the lesson's structure.
The verse says the waters will not come near, but it does not explicitly say whom they will not come near.
The psalm does not identify the speaker of verse 8 as the LORD, so the explanation should not assign the promise to Him.
David calls others to shout for joy; the psalm does not say he ends it shouting.
The psalm opens by describing the blessedness of forgiveness, not a man who stopped hiding. David describes acknowledging his sin later.
